branches.title: Rigid-object geometry in generated video
branches.question: Can a shape-sensitive score detect rigid objects that subtly change geometry while the camera moves?
branches.novelty: A detector that mistakes camera motion, occlusion or lighting changes for deformation is not valid.
branches.pilot: Render 20 known rigid 3D objects under controlled camera motion; introduce graded deformation; compare to MEt3R, temporal image similarity and human labels.
branches.stop: If it cannot distinguish deformation from viewpoint change on controlled scenes, stop.

branches.title: Mask selection as a side channel
branches.question: Does an adaptive mask reveal information about hidden tokens, even when the predictor never sees those tokens?
branches.novelty: Adaptive masking and information leakage already have literature; prove a distinct setting.
branches.pilot: Train a mask-only probe on a toy image dataset; compare independent masks, content-dependent masks and shuffled masks at equal ratios.
branches.stop: If an independent-mask control predicts equally well or novelty fails, retire or narrow.

branches.title: Interpretability of layer positions and feature routing
branches.question: Do particular attention heads or layer locations carry causal semantic information beyond easy probe correlations?
branches.novelty: Prior work already finds OCR heads with a verbalization lens; cannot repeat that claim.
branches.pilot: Replicate one released causal intervention on a small vision-language model; compare target-head ablation, layer-matched random heads and input controls.
branches.stop: If effects vanish against layer-matched controls, record a negative result.

branches.title: Entity linking recall under fixed candidate cost
branches.question: Can uncertainty-aware retrieval increase complete-link recall without inflating candidate lists?
branches.novelty: Blocking, multi-view retrieval and multilingual embeddings are mature; must show novel cost/recall trade-off.
branches.pilot: Use a frozen untouched stratified holdout; compare exact blocks, char n-grams, transliteration, adaptive caps and reverse retrieval at identical average candidate budget.
branches.stop: If pair recall improves but complete-link recall and cost do not, downgrade.

branches.title: Budget-matched pretraining data selection
branches.question: Can cheap data selection beat uniform sampling at the same tokens, wall-clock time, and selection overhead?
branches.novelty: Compare to strong recent data-mixture and data-selection baselines, not only uniform.
branches.pilot: Run small-model repeated seeds on fixed corpora, report selection compute plus training compute and held-out perplexity.
branches.stop: If total-cost gains disappear, pivot to an analysis of where selection fails.

branches.title: Do temporal boundaries help downstream memory?
branches.question: Can detected event boundaries improve temporal retrieval or question answering at equal frame budget?
branches.novelty: Boundary F1 alone cannot establish downstream usefulness.
branches.pilot: Compare ground-truth boundaries, predicted boundaries, uniform frames and random frames with the same total frames and fixed downstream model.
branches.stop: If gains disappear under matched budget or on untouched videos, stop.

branches.title: Structured conditions versus captions in action recognition
branches.question: When does verifying discrete temporal conditions outperform a descriptive video caption?
branches.novelty: Simple action benchmarks may make both approaches similar; avoid dataset-specific claims.
branches.pilot: Select temporal minimal-pair actions; fix the video encoder and reasoner, match inference tokens, compare condition-based and caption-based evidence.
branches.stop: If both are tied on hard temporal shifts, refocus on calibration/failure analysis.

branches.title: Agent-made experiments that survive audit
branches.question: Can a constrained research agent make real improvements under withheld tests and a counted human-intervention budget?
branches.novelty: Automation itself is no longer novel; study evaluation integrity and experimental reliability.
branches.pilot: Replicate a one-GPU autoresearch loop; test each accepted edit against frozen unseen seeds, fixed wall time and automatic rollback.
branches.stop: If held-out gains do not persist, publish an audit only if it provides generalizable evidence.

branches.title: Audio-event segmentation at matched compute
branches.question: Can a simple constrained decoder improve boundaries without a larger speech model?
branches.novelty: Event segmentation already has many decoders; inspect benchmark leakage and timing conventions.
branches.pilot: Compare fixed thresholds, median filtering, dynamic programming and uncertainty-aware decoders on held-out recordings.
branches.stop: If improvement is limited to one dataset or noisy labels, do not claim a general method.

branches.title: Physical simulator tests for generated video planning
branches.question: When does inconsistency in an imagined video produce invalid robot-planning decisions?
branches.novelty: Visual realism is not equal to downstream planning success; identify the causal link.
branches.pilot: Use a small grid/rigid-object simulator, perturb a generated roll-out while holding goals fixed, and score plan feasibility plus collision rate.
branches.stop: If image scores do not predict planning errors, report the counterexample.

branches.title: Small formal proofs for retrieval and selection
branches.question: Which simple assumptions guarantee a recall-cost bound for multi-route retrieval or adaptive sampling?
branches.novelty: A theorem needs nontrivial assumptions, an actual proof and numerical checks.
branches.pilot: State a two-route probabilistic model; derive a bound; brute-force check small instances and construct counterexamples.
branches.stop: If bound is vacuous under realistic distributions, retire.

branches.title: Transfer of synthetic-image evaluation to biology
branches.question: Do geometry metrics fail in predictable ways on microscopic synthetic sequences with no real paired view?
branches.novelty: Biomedical evaluation needs meaningful validated controls, not clinical claims.
branches.pilot: Use public synthetic cell-like renderings with controllable deformations and illumination; compare geometric and perceptual consistency metrics.
branches.stop: If results do not transfer beyond toy images, retain as a methods note only.

branches.title: Are networked research experiments truly reproducible?
branches.question: How often do agent-driven optimization claims vanish under controlled placement, contention and seed variance?
branches.novelty: A benchmark alone needs a novel reproducibility protocol or generalizable systems finding.
branches.pilot: Run small synthetic services with controlled load and resource contention; measure throughput, latency and variance before/after each agent change.
branches.stop: If differences are explainable by noise, don't claim an optimization.
